title: Texas Capital Bancshares, Inc. Begins Trading on TXSE Under New TXCP Ticker
summary: Company to celebrate primary listing transfer with closing bell ceremony in Dallas
body_markdown:
**DALLAS – November 9, 2026 –**[Texas Capital Bancshares, Inc.](https://texascapitalbank.com/) (TXSE: TXCP), the parent company of Texas Capital, today announced that the ticker symbols for its common and preferred stock have changed to “TXCP” and “TXCP PRB,” respectively, on the[Texas Stock Exchange](https://www.txse.com/) (“TXSE”), effective at market open. Texas Capital will commemorate the milestone with a closing bell ceremony in Dallas today.


All trading activity, regulatory filings, and market-related information will be reported under the new ticker symbols. No action is required by stockholders in connection with the ticker symbol change.


“As Texas continues to attract businesses, investment and talent from around the world, it is increasingly serving as a gateway to the global capital markets,” said Rob C. Holmes, Chairman, President & CEO of Texas Capital. “We are proud to be part of TXSE and support an exchange that expands access to capital from Texas, creating new opportunities for companies and investors alike. Our new ticker symbol reflects an inflection point in our evolution into the only full-service financial services firm founded and headquartered in Texas. We believe that the future of capital formation will increasingly be shaped by the companies, institutions and innovators here.”


The closing bell ceremony will bring together leaders from Texas Capital and TXSE, as well as members of the Texas business community, to recognize Texas Capital’s primary listing on the exchange. The ceremony will be livestreamed beginning at approximately 2:50 p.m. CT and can be viewed online[here](https://www.txse.com/live) .


The ticker change and closing bell mark the latest milestones in Texas Capital’s relationship with TXSE. On September 16, 2026, Texas Capital moved the primary listings of its two Texas-focused ETFs to TXSE, establishing the funds as TXSE’s first primary listings and the first funds to ever trade on a Texas exchange. Texas Capital Bancshares, Inc. followed on October 8, 2026, transferring the primary listings of its common and preferred stock.


## About Texas Capital


Texas Capital Bancshares, Inc. (TXSE: TXCP), a member of the Russell 2000® Index and the S&P MidCap 400®, is the parent company of Texas Capital Bank (“TCB”). Texas Capital is the collective brand name for TCB and its separate, non-bank affiliates and wholly owned subsidiaries. Texas Capital is a full-service financial services firm that delivers customized solutions to businesses, entrepreneurs and individual customers. Founded in 1998, the institution is headquartered in Dallas with offices in Austin, Fort Worth, Houston, San Antonio, Chicago, Los Angeles and New York City, and has a network of clients across the country. With the ability to service clients through their entire lifecycles, Texas Capital has established commercial banking, consumer banking, corporate and investment banking and wealth management capabilities. All services are subject to applicable laws, regulations and service terms. Deposit and lending products and services are offered by TCB. For deposit products, member FDIC. For more information, please visit[texascapital.com](https://texascapitalbank.com/) .


Trading in securities and financial instruments, strategic advisory, and other investment banking activities are performed by TCBI Securities, Inc., doing business as Texas Capital Securities. TCBI Securities, Inc. is a member of FINRA and SIPC and has registered with the SEC and other state securities regulators as a broker dealer. TCBI Securities, Inc. is a subsidiary of Texas Capital Bancshares, Inc. All investing involves risks, including the loss of principal. Past performance does not guarantee future results. Securities and other investment products offered by TCBI Securities, Inc. are not FDIC insured, may lose value and are not bank guaranteed.
